name: impeccable
title: impeccable
description: Designs, redesigns, critiques, audits, polishes and animates frontends — websites, dashboards, app UI, native screens and design systems — with 24 design commands, per-mode craft rules and a 62-rule anti-slop detector that verifies the rendered result. Runtime note: its launcher downloads the design engine binary from the project's own GitHub releases, SHA-256-verified against the manifest vendored in the skill; the per-edit detector hook is opt-in per project.
why: The design shelf's heavyweight: a design director's full command set plus a mechanical detector that catches slop after every edit — the closest thing to a standing design review in the collection.
